sourceFile: 10. BRS-161016 Report checking Gauss of CMG after dry_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but conflates separate SMG, CMG dry, and Yoke TF-vs-normal comparisons under an invalid filename-based changed factor.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not the tested condition.
Baseline and test conditions are left undefined despite visible before/after dry and TF/normal labels.
Separate report contexts are merged into one case.
Several FO outcomes are misparsed as sample indices, not FO values.
Many citations point to headers only, with weak result/decision support.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the 12.30 SMG sheet be a separate review case from the CMG dry report?
Should NTI/FO/SPL/THD be grouped under Yoke TF line vs Normal comparison?
correctionPlan: Replace filename factor with explicit conditions: before vs after dry CMG and Yoke TF line vs Normal as applicable.
Split or clearly subgroup the 12.30 SMG continuous vs delay jig content.
Reassign SPL, THD, FO, and Gauss outcomes to the correct changed factor.
Re-extract FO statistics from numeric value columns, excluding sample numbers.
Add concise citations to purpose, table headers, data rows, and decision rows for each case.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but current citations are insufficient for final evidence because grouping and metric extraction are unreliable.
